name: Observed listings
notes: Assigned listing/review sample only; no citywide representativeness is assumed. Exclude flag_L_DUP; other listing QA flags remain unless needed by the individual KPI.

name: Median validated advertised price
formula: median(configured price_col where price_valid is true and price is finite and positive)
notes: Assigned listing/review sample only; no citywide representativeness is assumed. QA currently validates the latest snapshot only. Unsupported earlier prices remain null; no price history is inferred.

name: Entire home share
notes: Assigned listing/review sample only; no citywide representativeness is assumed. Unknown room types are excluded from this denominator only; report n_valid.

name: Median minimum stay
notes: Assigned listing/review sample only; no citywide representativeness is assumed. Extreme minimum-night flags are retained; no short-stay cap is imposed.

name: Observed unavailable day share
notes: Assigned listing/review sample only; no citywide representativeness is assumed. Observed valid listing-days only, not a mean of listing rates. Unavailability includes blocked dates and is not occupancy, bookings, or revenue. Window and exposure may differ by snapshot.

name: Positive historical review share
formula: count(classified review IDs with sentiment positive) / count(classified review IDs)
dimensions: review date month or all historical dates; scope; neighbourhood_cleansed
notes: Assigned listing/review sample only; no citywide representativeness is assumed. Each review ID counts once. Review months describe writing dates, not snapshot trends. LLM labels are model judgments and the labeled subset may be biased; missing labels remain unknown.

name: Negative aspect mention share
objective: Identify guest concerns in classified reviews
formula: count(classified review IDs negatively mentioning the aspect) / count(classified review IDs)
dimensions: review date month or all historical dates; scope; neighbourhood_cleansed; aspect
notes: Assigned listing/review sample only; no citywide representativeness is assumed. Exact aspect tokens; empty aspects mean no detected mention. Aspects can co-occur and the same aspect can have both polarities. Shares need not sum to one; unclassified reviews are excluded.
